hypotheses.Q0_residual_codes_are_linearly_equivalen: Every gate-passing pure-rule candidate has ridge held-out R-squared at least 0.50 at every residual boundary.
hypotheses.Q1_residual_codes_are_orthogonally_equiv: Every gate-passing candidate has orthogonal held-out R-squared at least 0.30 at every residual boundary.
hypotheses.Q2_linear_map_conjugates_causal_tangents: Every gate-passing pure-rule candidate has median held-out causal-Jacobian cosine at least 0.70 at every boundary.
hypotheses.Q3_alignment_beats_shuffled_corresponden: Every gate-passing candidate beats its shuffled-pair ridge R-squared control by at least 0.30 at every boundary.
hypotheses.Q4_residual_coordinates_are_more_stable_: For every gate-passing pure-rule candidate and layer, residual-boundary ridge R-squared exceeds gate-activation ridge R-squared by at least 0.15.
hypotheses.Q5_causal_conjugacy_tracks_interface_fid: Mean worst-boundary causal cosine among gate-passing candidates exceeds failed-interface candidates by at least 0.10.
